meta.name: The Lost Pirate Kingdom
meta.description: The real-life pirates of the Caribbean violently plunder the world's riches and form a surprisingly egalitarian republic in this documentary series.

videos.title: Hoist the Black Flag
videos.overview: The War of the Spanish Succession ends, leaving thousands of Caribbean privateers unemployed. The wreck of a treasure fleet creates new opportunities.

videos.title: The Pirate Republic
videos.overview: Tensions rise between Benjamin Hornigold and Henry Jennings. Their rivalry takes a new direction when Hornigold declares Nassau a pirate republic.

videos.title: The Price of Loyalty
videos.overview: Hornigold's crew deposes him for his refusal to attack English ships, but Edward Thatch remains loyal. Pirate raids on British slavers provoke outrage.

videos.title: The Empire Strikes Back
videos.overview: English authorities tap Woodes Rogers to put a stop to pirate attacks. Black Sam Bellamy suffers a cruel fate at the height of his success.

videos.title: Deal or No Deal
videos.overview: Rogers' campaign begins with the offer of a pardon, which Hornigold and Jennings accept. But not all Nassau pirates agree. Thatch adopts a new image.

videos.title: Dead or Alive
videos.overview: Nassau comes under the control of Rogers, and the era of the pirate kingdom comes to a bloody close.
